description: Source code for the TranslatorESSL class, part of the ANGLE project, responsible for translating shaders to ESSL (OpenGL ES Shading Language). It includes methods for initializing built-in functions, translating shader code, handling extensions, and emulating features.

classes.name: TranslatorESSL
classes.description: A class responsible for translating shaders into ESSL (OpenGL ES Shading Language), including handling extensions, precision emulation, and built-in functions.

methods.name: TranslatorESSL
methods.description: Constructor initializing the TranslatorESSL with shader type and specification.

methods.name: initBuiltInFunctionEmulator
methods.description: Initializes built-in function emulators based on compile options.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Performs the translation of the shader AST, handling extensions, pragmas, precision, built-in functions, and output generation.

methods.name: shouldFlattenPragmaStdglInvariantAll
methods.description: Determines whether to flatten the stdgl invariant pragma; here, it always returns true for debugging purposes.

methods.name: writeExtensionBehavior
methods.description: Outputs extension behavior directives based on the extension settings and resource availability.
